title: Divider
description: A thin line that separates content, horizontally or vertically, optionally with text.

support.notes: Horizontal/vertical solid/dashed/dotted separators with thickness/length/spacing/text alignment/elevation/flexItem and optional label. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

translationResources.title: Divider
translationResources.description: A thin line that separates content, horizontally or vertically, optionally with text.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A horizontal divider separates the first and second sections.

with-text.title: With text
with-text.description: Compare Left, Center and Right labels; the right-aligned divider is dashed.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: Vertical dividers separate Home, Products and About.

custom-style.title: Custom style
custom-style.description: Set the line color with the --divider-color CSS custom property (inline style, class or ancestor), and customize thickness, length, spacing and the elevation shadow.

flex-item.title: In a flex container
flex-item.description: flexItem makes a vertical divider stretch to the height of its flex container.

DividerProps.length: Length of the line (width when horizontal, height when vertical)
DividerProps.spacing: Margin around the divider in pixels (top/bottom when horizontal, left/right when vertical)
DividerProps.children: Optional text rendered inside a horizontal divider
DividerProps.flexItem: Stretches a vertical divider to the height of its flex container
